KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. pana
   B. nene
   C. zito
   D. fupi

2. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.

3. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.

4. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.

5. When practising Anga, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Anga.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Anga.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Anga.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Anga.

6. When practising Huyo na Hao, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Huyo na Hao.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Huyo na Hao.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Huyo na Hao.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Huyo na Hao.

7. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   D. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.

8. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. kitoto
   B. mitoto
   C. mato
   D. watoto

9. When practising herufi kubwa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to herufi kubwa.
   B. Use insults to “practise” herufi kubwa.
   C. Copy random text without understanding herufi kubwa.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for herufi kubwa.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Nambari 11-50 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
